title: Invoices
intro: Supplier invoices checked against the PO and the goods received. Start with the drafts to check, then the exceptions and those pending approval.
forbiddenHint: Your account may not record invoices. If you need to, ask your organization's administrator to give you the finance role.

filter.label: Search invoices
filter.searchHint: Invoice number, supplier's invoice number, PO number or supplier name

list.label: Invoices in the {tab} tab
list.noSupplierNo: Supplier's invoice number not entered yet
list.limited: Showing the latest {shown}. Search to find others.

empty.draftHint: Record a new invoice from the supplier's file, or look at the mail in the inbox.
empty.exceptionsHint: Every submitted invoice matches its PO and goods received on every line.
empty.pendingHint: Invoices whose price variance is sent for approval show here.
empty.ready: No invoices ready for payment yet
empty.readyHint: An invoice that matches on every line, or whose variance is approved, is ready for payment.
empty.allHint: Start by recording a new invoice, or fetch the mail in the inbox.
empty.noMatchHint: Try a PO number or a supplier name, or clear the search.

inbox.title: Invoice inbox
inbox.intro: Mail in which suppliers send their invoices, fetched every 5 minutes. A file with a PO number becomes a draft to check; a file without one waits for you to choose its PO.
inbox.forbiddenHint: Your account may not manage the invoice inbox. If you need to, ask your organization's administrator to give you the finance role.
inbox.noAddress: Your organization has no inbox address yet, so no mail is fetched. Upload files for now.

poll.done: Mail fetched: {received} new messages, {drafts} drafts made, {failed} could not be read
poll.notConfigured: Mail cannot be fetched yet: there is no inbox address, or the mail reader is switched off.

inbox.failedDetail: The message could not be read ({code}), tried {attempts} times. If it still cannot be read, skip it with a reason.

skippedReason.TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: not a PDF, XML, JPEG or PNG file
skippedReason.OVER_LIMIT: more than 10 files in one message

inbox.search: Type a PO number or supplier name
inbox.noPo: No PO that can take an invoice was found
inbox.noRecord: Only members who may record invoices can make a draft from a file.

ignore.title: Skip this message
ignore.body: The message {subject} will not be used for an invoice, and this cannot be undone. Give a reason the auditors will see.
ignore.reasonHint: For example: advertising, or the supplier sent the file again. At most 500 characters.

inbox.empty: No mail in the inbox yet
inbox.emptyHint: Press "Fetch mail now" to look for new mail, or record an invoice from a file yourself.

new.title: Record a new invoice
new.intro: Choose the PO, then upload the supplier's invoice file. A draft is made for you to check and edit before submitting. A draft does not touch the budget.
new.poHint: POs sent to the supplier, received in part or in full, or closed
new.search: Type a PO number or supplier name
new.noPos: No PO can take an invoice yet
new.noPosHint: An invoice can be recorded once its PO is sent to the supplier. See the POs on the purchase orders page.
new.fileHint: PDF, XML, JPEG or PNG up to {mib} MB. An e-Tax file fills in the number, date and amounts; for other files you type them.
new.submitNoFile: Make a draft without a file
new.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {mib} MB. Make it smaller, or ask the supplier for the e-Tax file.
new.pickFileFirst: Choose a file first, or press "Make a draft without a file"

errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back. Check your connection and press again; it will not be done twice.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account may not do this
errors.MODULE_DISABLED: Your organization has not switched on payments, so this kind of invoice cannot be recorded
errors.NOT_FOUND: The PO or file is no longer there. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.INVALID_STATE: The status has changed. Reload the page to see it as it is now.
errors.INVOICE_TRACK_MISMATCH: This PO already has tax invoices recorded the earlier way, so this kind of invoice cannot be made on it. Choose another PO.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This was already sent with other values. Reload the page and do it again.
errors.FILE_TYPE: This file is not a PDF, XML, JPEG or PNG file
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large. Make it smaller, or ask the supplier for the e-Tax file.
errors.FILE_EMPTY: The file is empty. Choose another file.
errors.FILE_IN_USE: This file is already the file of another invoice
errors.FILE_UNREADABLE: The stored file cannot be read. Upload the file again.
errors.REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason is longer than 500 characters
errors.INVALID: Something is missing or wrong. Reload the page and try again.
errors.FAILED: It did not work. Try again; if it still fails, tell your administrator.
